title: 第二十五章 找麻烦第二十六章 学心拷问
lines: “尚少！”
曹雄一脸恭维。
“原来是曹老师，你找我？”尚斌疑惑的看过来。
都是学院老师，平时也有不少接触，却没怎么深交过。
“是这么回事，我有件事可能想要麻烦尚少一下！”曹雄犹豫了一下，道。
“只要我能帮忙，竭尽所能！”尚斌道。
做为尚臣长老的亲孙子，每天都能遇到不少老师过来求他，早已养成习惯。
“是这样的，我……昨天好不容易收了一个好学生，却被其他老师用哄骗的方法骗过去了，尚长老不是主管教导吗？我想问问……能不能把这个学生在给我调回来……”
曹雄道。
刘扬是他花费大心血招收最好的学生，结果却因一次比试输给了张悬，回去之后越想越气，今天再也忍不住，直接来找尚斌。
尚斌的爷爷尚臣长老，学院的教导主任，给学生换个老师，还是非常简单的。
“调回来？”尚斌眉头一皱：“如果那个学生是自愿的，很难！你也知道，现在学生比较麻烦，稍有不满，上告王庭、教师公会，我们……”
“他不是自愿的！我可以保证！”曹雄忙道。
“就算不是自愿，对方老师如果不愿意放手的话，也不太容易，你也知道学校的规矩……”尚斌摆了摆手，突然抬头：“你刚才说……哄骗？不知是哪位老师，把你学生骗过去了？”
“就是咱们学院的那个‘废物老师’张悬……”说起少年，曹雄牙齿咬紧，满脸都是恨意。
“张悬？你的学生，给他骗去了？”再次听到这个名字，尚斌怒火也一下燃烧起来。
要不是这家伙，昨天肯定能和女神一起共进晚餐，一个只有武者三重，师资考核只得零分的臭小子，居然敢无视自己的威严，真是不知死活！
要不是昨天女神在场，不方便动粗，肯定早打的他不知死活了！
“是！这样的老师，是个人也不愿意做他的学生吧！所以，我想麻烦尚少跟尚长老说一下，帮我再把他调回来……”曹雄小心翼翼的道，生怕对方不答应。
“不用和尚长老说，我现在就去帮你解决！”尚斌一摆手。
“帮我解决？”
“其他老师可能还要我爷爷帮忙协调，张悬这个废物，还用得着这么麻烦？直接过去要人就行，他不给，就把他打残！”
尚斌大手一挥，气势恢宏。
对付别的老师，他还真没办法，但对于这个师资考核为零分的家伙，想要出手教训太简单了！
实力差不说，关键是学院里根本不可能有人给他出头！
最重要的一点，自己正打算揍这家伙一顿出气，愁着没好理由！
没有理由就出手，给沈碧茹知道，肯定会留下不好的印象。
这下好了，他骗别人的学生，当事者找过来了，刚好可以借题发挥！
“这……”没想到尚斌如此大方，曹雄忍不住一愣。
“不用这了，那了，跟我走吧，你要是害怕，我替你出手！”尚斌嘴角扬起，眼中闪过一道残忍的光芒。
“那就多谢尚少了！”曹雄兴奋地眼睛一亮，连忙点头，二人同时向张悬的课堂大步走了过来。
时间不长，来到张悬的课堂门前，看到了木乃伊似的姚寒和王家大少。
“王涛，你不在爷爷那里好好修炼，来这干什？”尚斌眉头一皱。
content_en:
"Young Master Shang!"
Cao Xiong looked complimentary.
"So it's Teacher Cao, are you looking for me?" Shang Bin looked over in confusion.
They are both teachers in the college, and we have a lot of contact with them on a daily basis, but we have not had any deep friendship with them.
"That's what it is. I have something I might want to trouble Shang Shao less with!" Cao Xiong hesitated and said.
"As long as I can help, I will do my best!" Shang Bin said.
As the grandson of Elder Shangchen, he meets many teachers who come to him to beg him every day, and he has already developed a habit.
"It's like this. I... finally accepted a good student yesterday, but was deceived by other teachers. Isn't Elder Shang in charge of teaching? I would like to ask... if you can bring this student back to me..."
Cao Xiong said.
Liu Yang was the best student he had spent a lot of effort to recruit, but he lost to Zhang Xuan in a competition. After returning home, he became more and more angry after thinking about it. Today he couldn't bear it anymore and came directly to Shang Bin.
Shang Bin's grandfather, Elder Shang Chen, is the dean of education at the college. It is very simple for his students to find another teacher.
"Transferred back?" Shang Bin frowned: "If that student is voluntary, it will be difficult! You also know that students are in trouble now. If they are slightly dissatisfied, they can appeal to the Royal Court and the Teachers Association, and we..."
"He didn't do it voluntarily! I can guarantee that!" Cao Xiong said hurriedly.
"Even if it is not voluntary, it will not be easy if the other teacher is unwilling to let go. You also know the rules of the school..." Shang Bin waved his hand and suddenly raised his head: "You just said... coaxing? I wonder which teacher deceived your student?"
"That's the 'waste teacher' Zhang Xuan from our college..." Speaking of the young man, Cao Xiong clenched his teeth and his face was full of hatred.
"Zhang Xuan? Was your student deceived by him?" Hearing this name again, Shang Bin's anger suddenly burned.
If it weren't for this guy, I would have had dinner with the goddess yesterday. A brat who is only at the third level of a warrior and got zero points in the teacher assessment actually dares to ignore his majesty. He really doesn't want to live or die!
If the goddess hadn't been there yesterday and it was inconvenient to use violence, he would have been beaten to death!
"Yes! I don't want to be a student of such a teacher! So, I would like to trouble Young Master Shang to talk to Elder Shang and help me transfer him back..." Cao Xiong said cautiously, for fear that the other party would not agree.
"You don't need to say anything, Elder Monk, I will help you solve it now!" Shang Bin waved his hand.
"Help me solve it?"
"Other teachers may want my grandfather to help coordinate. Why does Zhang Xuan, a loser, need to go to such trouble? Just go and ask for someone. If he doesn't give, we'll cripple him!"
Shang Bin waved his hand with great momentum.
There's really nothing he can do against other teachers, but for this guy who got zero points in the teacher assessment, it's too easy to teach him a lesson!
Regardless of his strength, the key is that there is no way anyone in the academy can stand up for him!
The most important point is that I was planning to beat this guy up to vent my anger, but I was worried that there was no good reason!
Taking action without any reason would definitely leave a bad impression if Shen Biru knew about it.
Now it’s good, he deceived other people’s students, and the person involved found him, so he could use the topic to his advantage!
"This..." Unexpectedly, Shang Bin was so generous, and Cao Xiong couldn't help but be stunned.
"No need for this, then, come with me. If you are afraid, I will take action for you!" Shang Bin raised the corners of his mouth, and a cruel light flashed in his eyes.
"Then thank you so much, Mr. Shang!" Cao Xiong's eyes lit up with excitement, he nodded quickly, and the two of them strode towards Zhang Xuan's class at the same time.
Not long after, I arrived in front of Zhang Xuan's classroom and saw the mummy-like Yao Han and the eldest son of the Wang family.
"Wang Tao, if you don't practice hard at Grandpa's place, what are you doing here?" Shang Bin frowned.
